summary.text: Beth Doglio is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 22-Position 1 since January 9, 2023, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A longtime environmental advocate, she works for Climate Solutions.

paragraphs.text: Doglio earned a bachelor's degree in political science and telecommunications from Indiana University.

She founded the Washington Conservation Voters and served as its executive director from 1991 to 1995, and she has worked as a campaign organizer and development director for Audubon Washington and as a nonprofit campaign director at Climate Solutions.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Doglio said she is a longtime Olympia resident who chairs the House Environment & Energy Committee and serves on the Appropriations and State Government & Tribal Relations committees.

She listed her campaign priorities as affordability, including housing, energy costs, child care and health care; climate and clean energy; and protecting reproductive freedom, LGBTQIA+ rights, workers and the safety net.
